title: Custom Soccer Player Custom Name Number Comforter Set, Boys Room Decor
description:
Embrace the thrill of the game with our custom Soccer Player Comforter Set, designed to inspire young soccer enthusiasts. This personalized bedding from Jeminise is perfect for transforming any boys' room into a soccer haven, celebrating their passion for the sport and their favorite stars.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Ideal for young soccer fans, inspiring them to chase their dreams and fuel their excitement for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin, US Full, US Queen, and US King to fit various bed dimensions.
  • Easy to Use Bedding: Features a hidden zipper and a smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to prevent fading and ensure lasting color vibrancy.
  • Smooth Stitching: Edges of the blanket boast smooth, fine, and compact stitching for enhanced durability.
  • Machine Washable: Simple care for microfiber covers; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat.
  • Custom Options: Personalize with a name and number for a unique touch.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Sets
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Selected Design A4
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 1 text input
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Sham Quantity 2
Thread Count 360
